results.name: Custom background previews immediately and persists with player settings after reload
Saved color remains on other pages and white or black backgrounds adapt text contrast
Reset preview and save restore default theme without losing name or sound preference
Theme toggle exits custom color and custom controls fit a mobile viewport
No browser errors or external network calls and frozen build stays unchanged

limitations: Account identity and cloud transport are synthetic fixtures; persistence is real browser IndexedDB.
No hosted Supabase authentication, actual cross-device cloud sync or physical device was used.
